find: if (profile === undefined) throw new Error(`no AI profile for kind '${kind}'`);
why: Drops a tank kind the configuration does not describe instead of refusing. The measurement saw that tank and counted its AI-ticks, so dropping it here removes the ticks from every denominator while the changes it made are still grouped -- a profile would read a switch rate over a population that excludes the tank that switched. A kind added to tank-defs.json without an aiProfile is exactly how this arises.
killedBy: foldToProfiles refuses a kind the configuration does not map, rather than pooling it under undefined
